name: Nerona USD
oneLiner: USDnr is Nerona's permissioned 1:1 wrapper of M0's M token backed by short-term U.S. T-bills; T-bill yield accrues to M0 and Nerona, not USDnr holders.
collateral: Backed 1:1 by $M (M0 Protocol's tokenized short-term U.S. Treasury bill exposure, sourced from the M0 Minter MXON). USDnr is a permissioned wrapper minted by Nerona Labs against $M held in M0-managed reserves, with a Stability Reserve buffer maintained on top of circulating supply
pegMechanism: Permissioned 1:1 wrapper around M0's $M token: USDnr is minted by Nerona Labs by depositing/wrapping $M (sourced from MXON, the legal Minter on the M0 network) and burned 1:1 against $M on redemption. T-bill yield earned by the underlying $M accrues to the M0 reserve and Nerona — USDnr holders receive no rebase or NAV growth. The yield-bearing variant sUSDnr (Upshift ERC-4626 vault) routes that yield to stakers. Mint/redeem is gated to permissioned, KYC-onboarded clients of Nerona's private wealth platform
